tools.name: ask_telnyx
tools.description: Ask a natural-language question about Telnyx products, pricing, APIs, or policies. Returns NLWeb-format pointers to the canonical Telnyx resources that answer the question.

question.description: The question to ask, in plain language.

tools.name: get_docs_index
tools.description: Get the llms.txt index of machine-readable Telnyx documentation: product docs, API reference, pricing, policies, and agent onboarding, as a Markdown link list.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Get Telnyx product pricing as Markdown: voice, messaging, phone numbers, AI inference, storage and more, with links to the per-product pricing pages.

tools.name: site_info
tools.description: Return basic metadata about this Telnyx site (domain, public documentation URL).
